name: Deband
description: Removes banding by averaging four pseudo-random neighbours when they are close to the pixel.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Difference (0..1 of full range) below which a pixel counts as banding (`1thr`..`3thr`)

params.name: range
params.description: Distance in pixels of the reference points (`r`); a positive value is the maximum (random per pixel), a negative one the exact distance

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction of the reference points in radians (`d`); a positive value is the maximum (random per pixel), a negative one the exact angle

params.name: blur
params.description: 1 = compare the average of the four points with the pixel, 0 = compare each point (`b`)

params.name: coupling
params.description: 1 = all of R, G, B must pass for the pixel to change (`c`)
